summary: Analyzes pooled CRISPR knockout/CRISPRi/CRISPRa screens end to end: library design, screen QC, MAGeCK/BAGEL2/drugZ/JACKS hit calling, copy-number and batch correction, cross-method reconciliation, pipeline orchestration, pathway interpretation of hit lists, and CRISPResso2-based quantification of nuclease, base-editing, and prime-editing outcomes.
